scope: Linux bounded analysis and external command behavior; product readiness, query expansion, historical semantics and native non-Linux acceptance remain separate gates.

cli.completedCounts: Count only completed files and resources; canceled or undispatched inputs must not inflate completed counts.

invariants: closed URI clears are never lost
every query has exactly one terminal response
no stale epoch or revision output

expression: Deep, malformed and large expression inputs must be bounded before noncancellable parser calls and during AST work; a subsequent normal request must succeed in the same process.

snapshotTextBudget.loadedInput: One analysis invocation across loaded roots/scopes reserves all retained open buffers, then counts additional disk snapshot text. Shared authoritative overlays are not counted twice.
snapshotTextBudget.bufferStorage: One server-wide 128 MiB retained-text budget across all open roots and scopes, checked before snapshot construction.
snapshotTextBudget.diskConfiguration: Separate 1 MiB file bound; open configuration buffer text counts in server-wide buffer storage.
snapshotTextBudget.boundary: Exactly 128 MiB is permitted; one byte over reports a resource reason without treating any truncated scope as complete.
snapshotTextBudget.recovery: A refused buffer cannot fall back to disk or supply stale text to queries/edits; a full replacement after freeing space or close/reopen restores it.
